post.originalText:
"Make a motion graphics video that explains how the First & 10 Yellow Line works." 
Opus 5.5

This is mostly correct with the old sensor based system. The stadium it created looks like a bathtub and the sound is not great but I think this is a great result for one days work.

Next up will be an interactive demo.
